description.value: Kozak Ukrainian Eatery is an authentic Ukrainian restaurant and cafe in downtown New Westminster, serving homemade Ukrainian food in a sit-down setting with both indoor and outdoor seating. Tagged as a bakery in OSM, it likely offers baked goods alongside prepared meals, making it a potential stop for cyclists seeking a hearty, home-style meal. The eatery accepts credit and debit cards and has limited wheelchair accessibility.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces) at 24m; stands (6 spaces) at 51m; stands at 96m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is heavily dominated by cookie consent and analytics boilerplate, with no substantive page content extractable about amenities, bike parking, water, or groceries. The OSM tags confirm this is a real, operating Ukrainian eatery with indoor and outdoor seating, accepts credit/debit cards, and has a wheelchair=limited tag. No evidence exists in either source for bike parking, water refill, or most optional amenities; hot food is strongly implied by 'Ukrainian Eatery' and 'indoor_seating=yes' but the website text does not explicitly confirm menu items.
concerns: Category assigned as 'Groceries' but OSM tags shop=bakery and website describes it as a restaurant/cafe — may warrant recategorization to Restaurant or Cafe.
Website content was almost entirely cookie consent boilerplate; no substantive amenity or contact information could be extracted from the fetched pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Ukrainian restaurant and cafe in New Westminster with a confirmed website and OSM record; a useful food stop for touring cyclists regardless of confirmed cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.notes: The website uses Square for online ordering and Weebly as its platform. The contact page (/contact-us) was fetched but yielded no extractable contact details due to cookie wall rendering.

provenance.category_correction_reason: OSM tags this as shop=bakery and the website title calls it an 'Authentic Ukrainian Restaurant and Cafe' — it is more accurately a restaurant/cafe than a grocery store, but it may sell baked goods to go, so leaving category as-is pending review.
